spec.title: Mosaic gallery
spec.description: Mosaic's examples on Chaski, each with something only Grafana adds: brushes that drive Grafana panels through cross-filters, live data and extra views.

source.sql:
SELECT *, make_date(2012, month(date), day(date))::TIMESTAMP AS month_day
FROM read_parquet('https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/data/seattle-weather.parquet')

SELECT id, name, nationality, sex, height, weight, sport, gold, silver, bronze,
  gold + silver + bronze AS medals
FROM read_parquet('https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/data/athletes.parquet')

SELECT row_number() OVER () AS id, longitude, latitude, u, v, sqrt(u * u + v * v) AS speed
FROM read_parquet('https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/data/wind.parquet')

SELECT
  f.id AS id,
  to_timestamp(f.properties.time / 1000) AS time,
  f.geometry.coordinates[1]::DOUBLE AS longitude,
  f.geometry.coordinates[2]::DOUBLE AS latitude,
  f.geometry.coordinates[3]::DOUBLE AS depth,
  f.properties.mag::DOUBLE AS mag,
  f.properties.place::VARCHAR AS place,
  f.properties.url::VARCHAR AS url
FROM read_json('https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/2.5_month.geojson'), unnest(features) AS t(f)
WHERE f.properties.mag IS NOT NULL

SELECT ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(to_json(f.geometry)) AS geom
FROM read_json('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson'), unnest(features) AS t(f)

spec.title: Flights
spec.description: Flights the brushes leave, counted by Chaski SQL from the variables the Mosaic panels write.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS flights FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)

spec.title: On time
spec.description: Share arriving no more than 15 minutes late.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg((delay <= 15)::INT)::DOUBLE AS on_time FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)

spec.title: Mean delay
spec.description: Mean arrival delay of the selected flights; early arrivals count as negative.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg(delay)::DOUBLE AS delay FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)

spec.title: Mean distance
spec.description: Mean distance flown by the selected flights.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg(distance)::DOUBLE AS distance FROM $flights WHERE $__crossfilter($flightFilters)

spec.title: Arrival delay (min)
spec.description: Drag to select a range. Every panel on this tab follows: the Mosaic charts in the browser, the cards above through Chaski SQL.

options.spec:
params:
  fbrush: { select: crossfilter }
plot:
  - mark: rectY
    data: { from: flights, filterBy: $fbrush }
    x: { bin: delay }
    y: { count: }
    fill: "#5794F2"
    inset: 0.5
  - select: intervalX
    as: $fbrush
xDomain: Fixed
yTickFormat: '~s'
xLabel: null
yLabel: null
marginLeft: 40
options.variables:
- param: fbrush
  column: delay
  from: f_delay_lo
  to: f_delay_hi

spec.title: Delay by departure time
spec.description: Density of 230 000 flights computed in DuckDB, contour lines over it. Drag a box to select a region: it joins the histograms' brushes.

options.spec:
params:
  fbrush: { select: crossfilter }
plot:
  - mark: heatmap
    data: { from: flights, filterBy: $fbrush }
    x: time
    y: delay
    fill: density
    bandwidth: 6
  - mark: contour
    data: { from: flights, filterBy: $fbrush }
    x: time
    y: delay
    stroke: white
    strokeOpacity: 0.35
    bandwidth: 6
    thresholds: 8
  - select: intervalXY
    as: $fbrush
xDomain: [0, 24]
yDomain: [-60, 180]
colorScale: sqrt
colorScheme: turbo
xLabel: Departure (hour) →
yLabel: ↑ Arrival delay (min)
marginLeft: 45
options.variables:
- param: fbrush
  column: [time, delay]
  from: [f_box_time_lo, f_box_delay_lo]
  to: [f_box_time_hi, f_box_delay_hi]

spec.title: Active filters

spec.rawSql: SELECT label AS Filter, value AS Range FROM $__filters($flightFilters) WHERE active

spec.title: Days
spec.description: Days in 2012–2015 the selection leaves.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS days FROM $weather WHERE $__crossfilter($weatherFilters)

spec.title: Mean high
spec.description: Mean daily maximum temperature.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg(temp_max)::DOUBLE AS t FROM $weather WHERE $__crossfilter($weatherFilters)

spec.title: Precipitation per day
spec.description: Mean daily precipitation.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg(precipitation)::DOUBLE AS p FROM $weather WHERE $__crossfilter($weatherFilters)

spec.title: Sunny days
spec.description: Share of the selected days whose weather was sun.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg((weather = 'sun')::INT)::DOUBLE AS s FROM $weather WHERE $__crossfilter($weatherFilters)

spec.title: Seattle weather, 2012–2015
spec.description: Each dot is a day: its high temperature, sized by precipitation. Drag across to select days of the year; click a weather type in the legend or the bars to keep only it.

options.spec:
params:
  wclick: { select: single }
  wrange: { select: intersect }
  wdomain: [sun, fog, drizzle, rain, snow]
  wcolors: ['#e7ba52', '#a7a7a7', '#aec7e8', '#1f77b4', '#9467bd']
vconcat:
  - legend: color
    for: wscatter
    as: $wclick
  - name: wscatter
    plot:
      - mark: dot
        data: { from: weather, filterBy: $wclick }
        x: { dateMonthDay: date }
        y: temp_max
        fill: weather
        r: precipitation
        fillOpacity: 0.7
      - select: intervalX
        as: $wrange
        brush: { fill: none, stroke: '#888' }
      - select: highlight
        by: $wrange
        fill: '#ccc'
        fillOpacity: 0.2
    xyDomain: Fixed
    xTickFormat: '%b'
    colorDomain: $wdomain
    colorRange: $wcolors
    rDomain: Fixed
    rRange: [2, 10]
    xLabel: null
    yLabel: ↑ High (°C)
options.variables:
- param: wrange
  column: date
  from: w_lo
  to: w_hi
- param: wclick
  column: weather
  variable: w_types

spec.title: Rio 2016 athletes
spec.description: The menus and the search box are filled from the data. They filter every panel on this tab.

options.spec:
params:
  acategory: { select: intersect }
  aquery: { select: intersect, include: $acategory }
  ahover: { select: intersect, empty: true }

hconcat:
  - input: menu
    label: Sport
    as: $acategory
    from: athletes
    column: sport
  - input: menu
    label: Sex
    as: $acategory
    from: athletes
    column: sex
  - input: search
    label: Name
    filterBy: $acategory
    as: $aquery
    from: athletes
    column: name
    type: contains
options.variables:
- param: acategory
  column: sport
  variable: a_sport
- param: acategory
  column: sex
  variable: a_sex
- param: aquery
  column: name
  variable: a_name

spec.title: Athletes
spec.description: Athletes the menus, search and brush leave.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM $athletes WHERE $__crossfilter($athleteFilters)

spec.title: Medals
spec.description: Gold, silver and bronze they won.

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(medals), 0)::DOUBLE AS m FROM $athletes WHERE $__crossfilter($athleteFilters)
SELECT avg(height)::DOUBLE AS h FROM $athletes WHERE $__crossfilter($athleteFilters)

spec.title: Weight and height
spec.description: One dot per athlete, with a regression line per sex. Drag a box to select athletes by build; hover a row of the table to find them here.

options.spec:
params:
  acategory: { select: intersect }
  aquery: { select: intersect, include: $acategory }
  ahover: { select: intersect, empty: true }

plot:
  - mark: dot
    data: { from: athletes, filterBy: $aquery }
    x: weight
    y: height
    fill: sex
    r: 2
    opacity: 0.15
  - mark: regressionY
    data: { from: athletes, filterBy: $aquery }
    x: weight
    y: height
    stroke: sex
  - select: intervalXY
    as: $aquery
    brush: { fillOpacity: 0, stroke: currentColor }
  - mark: dot
    data: { from: athletes, filterBy: $ahover }
    x: weight
    y: height
    fill: sex
    stroke: currentColor
    strokeWidth: 1
    r: 4
xyDomain: Fixed
colorDomain: Fixed
colorRange: ['#FF9830', '#5794F2']
xLabel: Weight (kg) →
yLabel: ↑ Height (m)
options.variables:
- param: aquery
  column: [weight, height]
  from: [a_w_lo, a_h_lo]
  to: [a_w_hi, a_h_hi]

spec.title: Wind
spec.description: Vectors on a grid show the direction and speed of the wind, computed in DuckDB. Drag a box, or pick speeds in the legend or the histogram, to highlight vectors.

options.spec:
params:
  wselected: { select: union }
  wlength: 2

vconcat:
  - legend: color
    for: wind-map
    label: Speed (m/s)
    as: $wselected
  - name: wind-map
    plot:
      - mark: vector
        data: { from: wind }
        x: longitude
        y: latitude
        rotate: { sql: "degrees(atan2(u, v))" }
        length: { sql: $wlength * speed }
        stroke: speed
        channels: { id: id }
      - select: region
        as: $wselected
        channels: ['id']
      - select: highlight
        by: $wselected
    lengthScale: identity
    colorZero: true
    colorScheme: turbo
    inset: 10
    xLabel: null
    yLabel: null
  - input: slider
    min: 1
    max: 7
    step: 0.1
    as: $wlength
    label: Vector length

spec.title: Speeds
spec.description: The plus: drag across the speeds to highlight their vectors on the map.

options.spec:
params:
  wselected: { select: union }
  wlength: 2

plot:
  - mark: rectY
    data: { from: wind }
    x: { bin: speed }
    y: { count: }
    fill: '#5794F2'
    inset: 0.5
  - select: intervalX
    as: $wselected
  - select: highlight
    by: $wselected
xLabel: Speed (m/s) →
yLabel: null

options.content:
**4,800 wind vectors** on a regular grid, the [Observable Plot wind map](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-wind-map) data.

- The **direction** (`atan2(u, v)`), **length** and **colour** of each arrow are computed by DuckDB in your browser.
- The map, legend and histogram share one selection: what you pick in one is highlighted in the others.
- The slider rescales the arrows without a new query.

spec.title: Earthquakes
spec.description: Magnitude 2.5 and above in the last 30 days, from the USGS feed, left by the brushes.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM $quakes WHERE $__crossfilter($quakeFilters)
SELECT max(mag)::DOUBLE AS m FROM $quakes WHERE $__crossfilter($quakeFilters)
SELECT median(depth)::DOUBLE AS d FROM $quakes WHERE $__crossfilter($quakeFilters)

spec.title: Shallow
spec.description: Share shallower than 70 km, the ones felt most.

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg((depth < 70)::INT)::DOUBLE AS s FROM $quakes WHERE $__crossfilter($quakeFilters)

spec.title: The last 30 days, live
spec.description: Earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 and above from the USGS real-time feed, read by your browser when the dashboard opens. Turn the globe with the sliders; brush the histograms to filter it.

options.spec:
params:
  qbrush: { select: crossfilter }

  qlon: 80
  qlat: 5
  qrotate: [$qlon, $qlat]
vconcat:
  - hconcat:
      - input: slider
        label: Longitude
        as: $qlon
        min: -180
        max: 180
        step: 1
      - input: slider
        label: Latitude
        as: $qlat
        min: -90
        max: 90
        step: 1
  - plot:
      - mark: sphere
        fill: '#0b1d33'
        stroke: currentColor
        strokeOpacity: 0.3
      - mark: graticule
        strokeOpacity: 0.12
      - mark: geo
        data: { from: land }
        geometry: { geojson: geom }
        fill: currentColor
        fillOpacity: 0.18
        stroke: currentColor
        strokeOpacity: 0.3
      - mark: dot
        data: { from: quakes, filterBy: $qbrush }
        x: longitude
        y: latitude
        r: { sql: "POW(10, mag)" }
        fill: depth
        fillOpacity: 0.55
        stroke: white
        strokeWidth: 0.3
    projectionType: orthographic
    projectionRotate: $qrotate
    rRange: [1, 22]
    colorScheme: plasma
    colorReverse: true
    margin: 10

spec.title: Strongest in the selection
spec.description: Chaski SQL over the same data, following the brushes through the variables they write. The place links to the USGS event page.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Time (UTC)", mag AS "Magnitude", round(depth) AS "Depth (km)", place AS "Place", url
FROM $quakes WHERE $__crossfilter($quakeFilters)
ORDER BY mag DESC
LIMIT 25
